en: The image shows a scenic landscape with a tranquil pond or small lake with rowboats, surrounded by lush greenery and rolling hills. To the left, there is a classical building with a distinctive turret, outdoor seating and a person standing with a bicycle. In the foreground, a young child stands near the fence by the water, looking at the lake. The colors and attire suggest an early 20th-century setting. The printed text at the top says '1772 Graz - Hilmteich'.
